title: How to Increase Public Support for Carbon Pricing with Revenue Recycling
title_zh: DP19590 如何通过收入循环提高公众对碳定价的支持
authors: Andrej Woerner, Taisuke Imai, Davide Pace, Klaus Schmidt, Andrej Woerner; Taisuke Imai; Davide Pace; Klaus Schmidt
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Carbon pricing is a powerful but politically contentious tool for tackling climate change. Governments can, however, try to increase public support for it by adjusting how the revenues raised by the carbon price are used. In a fully incentivised experiment with a large representative sample of the German population, we compare voter support for five different carbon pricing schemes. We show that uniform carbon dividends (equal per capita transfers to all citizens) receive substantially more support than a carbon dividend that favours poorer people, than earmarking revenues for climate projects, and especially than using revenues for the general government budget. Among the uniform carbon dividend schemes, a Climate Premium that pays a fixed upfront transfer equal to the expected carbon revenues receives more support than a carbon dividend scheme where the size of the transfer is determined ex-post based on the actual revenues. Furthermore, we show that participants and experts underestimate public support for carbon pricing. These findings suggest that policies for sustainable development gain more support when affected voters are uniformly compensated for the costs imposed on them. In addition, the paper highlights the importance of incentivised experiments in studying public support for such policies.
abstract_zh: 碳定价是应对气候变化的有力但政治上具有争议性的工具。然而，政府可以通过调整碳定价所产生收入的用途来尝试提升公众对其的支持。在一项针对德国人口大规模代表性样本的完全激励实验中，我们比较了选民对五种不同碳定价方案的支持度。研究表明，统一碳红利（向所有公民按人均等额转移支付）获得的公众支持显著高于偏向贫困群体的碳红利、将收入专项用于气候项目，尤其是将收入纳入政府一般预算的方案。在统一碳红利方案中，预先支付相当于预期碳收入固定金额的"气候溢价"方案，比根据实际收入事后确定转移规模的碳红利方案获得更多支持。此外，我们发现参与者和专家均低估了公众对碳定价的支持度。这些发现表明，当受影响选民因政策成本获得统一补偿时，可持续发展政策能获得更多支持。同时，本文强调了激励实验在研究此类政策公众支持度中的重要性。

title: Inference with AI-Generated Covariates
title_zh: 使用AI生成协变量的推断
authors: Junting Duan, Markus Pelger
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to extract structured features, such as sentiment scores, classifications, and expectations, from unstructured data and treat these generated features as observed covariates in downstream estimation. This practice can invalidate inference when systematic, input-dependent errors in generated features, such as hallucination and look-ahead bias, distort the downstream moment conditions. Even after correction, generated features remain noisy proxies whose error profiles differ across models and prompts. We introduce AI-Powered Inference (AI-PI), a method-of-moments framework for valid and efficient inference that combines three components: a moment-specific bias correction based on a small human-labeled calibration set; adaptive weights that optimally combine multiple model-prompt pairs; and an optimal calibration-set design that concentrates costly human labels where the generated features are least reliable. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the AI-PI estimator, allowing for data-adaptive labeling designs, cross-fitted LLM-pipeline tuning, and overidentified GMM. Simulations confirm substantial gains over naive LLM regressions and over debiasing without optimal weighting or labeling design. In an application to news-based sentiment and stock returns, AI-PI produces stable conclusions where naive analyses vary substantially across LLM and prompt choices, with a confidence interval roughly half as long as using the human-labeled data alone.
abstract_zh: 实证研究者越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLMs）从非结构化数据中提取结构化特征（如情感得分、分类和预期），并将这些生成的特征作为下游估计中的观测协变量。当生成特征中存在系统性、依赖于输入的误差（如幻觉和前瞻性偏差）扭曲下游矩条件时，这种做法可能导致推断失效。即使经过修正，生成特征仍是带有噪声的代理变量，其误差特征因模型和提示词的不同而存在差异。我们提出AI驱动推断（AI-PI），这是一种基于矩方法的框架，用于实现有效且高效的推断，它结合了三个组成部分：基于少量人工标注校准集的矩特定偏差修正；能够最优组合多个模型-提示词对的自适应权重；以及将昂贵的人工标注集中于生成特征最不可靠区域的最优校准集设计。我们建立了AI-PI估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，允许数据自适应标注设计、交叉拟合的LLM流水线调优以及过度识别的广义矩估计（GMM）。模拟结果证实，与朴素LLM回归以及未采用最优权重或标注设计的去偏方法相比，该方法具有显著优势。在基于新闻的情感与股票收益的应用中，AI-PI得出了稳定的结论，而朴素分析在不同LLM和提示词选择下结果差异显著，其置信区间长度约为仅使用人工标注数据时的一半。

title: What Drives Crypto Mining? Evidence from Hardware Imports
title_zh: 什么驱动了加密货币挖矿？来自硬件进口的证据
authors: Andras Komaromi & Federico Grinberg & Mr. Diego A. Cerdeiro & Yang Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Understanding financial activity beyond traditional regulatory frameworks is essential for policymakers. Yet cryptocurrency mining—which offers a direct entry point into the crypto ecosystem without relying on traditional financial intermediaries—remains highly opaque. We propose a novel measurement approach using detailed customs data that tracks exports of crypto mining hardware from the world’s dominant producers. This trade-based proxy allows us to analyze the global distribution of mining hardware imports and identify their key drivers, guided by a stylized model. Empirically, mining surges respond strongly to global factors such as cryptocurrency prices and hardware costs, while domestic factors—including electricity prices and ambient temperature—shape the cross-country distribution of activity. Our findings highlight how global crypto markets, natural endowments, and policy choices jointly influence mining incentives, offering valuable insights for policymakers concerned with financial stability risks and energy subsidy misuse.
abstract_zh: 理解传统监管框架之外的金融活动对政策制定者至关重要。然而，加密货币挖矿——作为无需依赖传统金融中介即可直接进入加密生态系统的途径——仍然高度不透明。我们提出了一种新颖的测量方法，利用详细的关税数据追踪全球主要生产商出口的加密挖矿硬件。这一基于贸易的代理变量使我们能够分析挖矿硬件进口的全球分布，并借助一个简化模型识别其关键驱动因素。实证结果显示，挖矿活动激增对加密货币价格和硬件成本等全球因素反应强烈，而国内因素——包括电价和环境温度——则塑造了活动的跨国分布。我们的发现揭示了全球加密市场、自然禀赋和政策选择如何共同影响挖矿激励，为关注金融稳定风险和能源补贴滥用的政策制定者提供了宝贵见解。

title: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition
title_zh: 元素周期表的过高特权？地缘经济学、内生中心性与绿色转型的战略矿产
authors: Evgenia Passari, Hélène Rey, Evgenia Passari; Hélène Rey
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国持有的相关储量极少。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成——这是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型对此进行形式化，在该模型中，国家自主选择中心化程度，并证明中心化映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求与边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的商品特定供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美欧消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心化不仅是描述性特征：它创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

title: Special Issue: Climate Change and Inequality
title_zh: 特刊：气候变化与不平等
authors: Alberto Bisin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This Special Issue of The Economic Journal brings together papers at the frontier of dynamic, spatial and heterogeneous-agent structural modelling for the study of climate change and climate policy. These models are designed to be consistent with the fundamentals of climate science and to be calibrated and/or taken to the data. In this respect, Eftekhari, Folini, Friedl, Kubler, Scheidegger and Schenk contribute a methodological paper to the Issue, developing efficient climate emulators that can be embedded within economic models of climate change. Centring on the link between climate change and inequality, the papers in the Issue span different, and often complementary, dimensions of heterogeneity in the effects of climate change and various mitigation policies, most notably carbon taxes. Taken together, they show that the distributional consequences of climate action depend crucially on where a policy is implemented, how markets transmit shocks across regions and countries, and which households or regions are most exposed through income, wealth, consumption baskets, production structures or demographic characteristics.
abstract_zh: 《经济学期刊》本期特刊汇集了运用动态、空间及异质性主体结构模型研究气候变化与气候政策的前沿论文。这些模型旨在与气候科学基本原理保持一致，并经过校准和/或实证数据验证。基于此，Eftekhari、Folini、Friedl、Kubler、Scheidegger与Schenk为本期特刊贡献了一篇方法论论文，开发了可嵌入气候变化经济模型的高效气候模拟器。围绕气候变化与不平等之间的关联，本期论文涵盖了气候变化及各类减缓政策（尤其是碳税）影响中不同且常具互补性的异质性维度。综合来看，这些研究表明：气候行动分配效应的关键取决于政策实施地点、市场如何跨区域和国家传导冲击，以及哪些家庭或地区通过收入、财富、消费篮子、生产结构或人口特征面临最大风险。

title: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
title_zh: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据
authors: Soye Shin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Conventional price indexes partially address product heterogeneity. This paper considers the variety and quality of products in each market, the combination of region and year, and constructs panel price indexes using household scanner data on non‐alcoholic beverages in urban China. By comparing our panel price indexes to a conventional one, we find that ignoring product heterogeneity could largely underestimate the cross‐market price differences for non‐alcoholic beverages. We also find that product variety increases with urban population and income per capita, but that quality decreases with urban population, suggesting that wealthier provincial urban markets tend to have higher consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统价格指数仅部分解决了产品异质性问题。本文考虑每个市场（即地区与年份的组合）中产品的品种与质量，利用中国城市非酒精饮料的家庭扫描数据构建了面板价格指数。通过将我们的面板价格指数与传统价格指数进行比较，我们发现忽略产品异质性可能会严重低估非酒精饮料的跨市场价格差异。研究还发现，产品品种随城市人口和人均收入增加而增加，但质量随城市人口增加而下降，这表明更富裕的省级城市市场往往具有更高的消费者福利。

title: How Climate Shocks Produce Armed Rebellion: The 1970 Bhola Cyclone and the Birth of Bangladesh
title_zh: 气候冲击如何引发武装叛乱：1970年波拉气旋与孟加拉国的诞生
authors: Sultan Mehmood, Ahmed Mushfiq Mobarak
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why do climate shocks produce conflict (Hsiang et al., 2013)? We study the 1970 Bhola cyclone in East Pakistan, one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history, which killed an estimated 350,000 people. Using satellite imagery, archival records, electoral returns, and insurgent biographies, we show that cyclone exposure amplified pre-existing separatist sentiment at the ballot box and increased citizens’ subsequent participation in guerrilla warfare against the state. Our estimates imply that exposure to the cyclone’s devastation induced an additional 48,613 insurgents to join the guerrilla war effort. Effects are larger in areas with pre-existing political and economic grievances and weaker relief provision. Our analysis reveals the step-by-step mechanisms through which environmental shocks can produce conflict: they shift voting behavior, expose state indifference, and convert grievance into armed mobilization.
abstract_zh: 气候冲击为何会引发冲突（Hsiang等，2013）？我们以1970年东巴基斯坦博拉气旋为研究对象，这是有记录以来最致命的自然灾害之一，造成约35万人死亡。通过卫星影像、档案记录、选举结果和叛乱分子传记资料，我们证明气旋暴露程度放大了选票箱中既有的分离主义情绪，并增加了公民随后参与针对国家的游击战行为。我们的估算表明，遭受气旋破坏的地区额外催生了48,613名叛乱分子加入游击战。在既有政治经济不满情绪更强烈且救济供给更薄弱的地区，影响更为显著。本分析揭示了环境冲击引发冲突的逐步传导机制：改变投票行为、暴露国家冷漠态度、将不满情绪转化为武装动员。

title: On the optimality of social security instruments
title_zh: 论社会保障工具的最优性
authors: Pablo Garcia‐Sanchez, Luca Marchiori, Olivier Pierrard
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Public pension and public health care policies – collectively referred to here as social security policies – are costly and increasingly challenged by demographic shifts. Using a two‐period overlapping generations model in which health investment affects both mortality and morbidity, we analytically study the optimal design of social security. Our model incorporates three market imperfections: an intergenerational externality, a constraint on saving for future consumption, and incomplete insurance markets. It also considers three policy instruments: subsidies for health investment, subsidies for health expenditures, and a pay‐as‐you‐go pension replacement rate. We analyze how the imperfections, along with evolving trends in mortality and morbidity, shape the optimal set‐up of social security policies. Our findings show that there is no universal design for optimal social security: the effectiveness of each instrument depends on the others and on market conditions, with stronger prevention policies emerging as key in aging societies and in systems with less generous pensions.
abstract_zh: 公共养老金与公共医疗政策——统称为社会保障政策——成本高昂，且日益受到人口结构变化的挑战。本文采用一个两期世代交叠模型（其中健康投资同时影响死亡率和发病率），从理论层面分析社会保障的最优设计。模型纳入三种市场不完善因素：代际外部性、未来消费储蓄约束以及不完全保险市场；同时考虑三种政策工具：健康投资补贴、医疗支出补贴以及现收现付制养老金替代率。我们分析了这些市场不完善因素如何与死亡率和发病率的演变趋势共同塑造社会保障政策的最优配置。研究结果表明，最优社会保障并不存在统一模式：每种工具的有效性取决于其他工具及市场条件，在老龄化社会及养老金待遇较低的制度中，强化预防性政策成为关键举措。

title: The Interplay of Halal Operations Management and Supply Chain Integration on Logistics Performance in West Java's SMEs
title_zh: 西爪哇中小企业中清真运营管理与供应链整合对物流绩效的交互作用
authors: Tribowo Rachmat Fauzan, Ajeung Syilva Syara Noor Silmi Sudrajat
official: 官方在线 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The global expansion of the halal industry has placed considerable pressure on food supply chains, particularly among small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in West Java's food sector. This research examines the interplay between halal operations management practices and supply chain integration to determine their combined effects on logistics performance, addressing persistent gaps in halal logistics efficiency. A quantitative approach employing partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) analyzes survey responses from 186 food SMEs across West Java, treating halal operations management and supply chain integration as key independent constructs, with logistics performance as the dependent variable; mediation effects were tested through bootstrapping procedures. Halal operations management significantly improves logistics performance, while supply chain integration fully mediates this relationship — West Java SMEs show measurable gains in on-time delivery and inventory efficiency when halal practices are structurally aligned with supply chain coordination. The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and findings may not generalize beyond food SMEs in West Java; future research should examine longitudinal effects and multi-sector applications across Indonesia. This study is among the first to connect halal operations management with supply chain integration in explaining logistics performance among Indonesian SMEs, addressing theoretical gaps between Islamic business practices and modern supply chain theory while offering a practical framework for West Java's halal sector development.
abstract_zh: 全球清真产业的扩张对食品供应链造成了显著压力，尤其是对西爪哇食品行业的中小企业（SMEs）而言。本研究探讨了清真运营管理实践与供应链整合之间的相互作用，以确定其对物流绩效的综合影响，从而解决清真物流效率中持续存在的空白。采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）的定量方法，分析了来自西爪哇186家食品中小企业的调查数据，将清真运营管理和供应链整合作为关键自变量，物流绩效作为因变量；通过自助法程序检验中介效应。清真运营管理显著提升了物流绩效，而供应链整合完全中介了这一关系——当清真实践与供应链协调在结构上保持一致时，西爪哇中小企业在准时交付和库存效率方面表现出可衡量的改善。横截面设计限制了因果推断，研究结果可能无法推广至西爪哇以外的食品中小企业；未来研究应考察纵向效应及印度尼西亚多行业应用。本研究首次将清真运营管理与供应链整合联系起来，以解释印度尼西亚中小企业的物流绩效，填补了伊斯兰商业实践与现代供应链理论之间的理论空白，同时为西爪哇清真产业发展提供了实用框架。

title: How Do Large Epidemics Redistribute Market Power? Evidence from the 2003 SARS Shock in China
title_zh: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据
authors: Yating Jiang, Hongsong Zhang
official: 官方发布 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Market power is costly to build and, once established, is typically persistent and difficult to change. This paper investigates the impact of large economic shocks (serious epidemics) on the redistribution of market power in manufacturing industries. Using a model of firms’ dynamic decisions on production, pricing, and inventory holding, we demonstrate the importance of inventory stock and demand uncertainty in understanding market power and propose a new measure of market power. We find that the 2003 SARS shock in China significantly reduced the market power of firms in SARS-impacted areas. This effect is long lasting. SARS also substantially increased the inventory of affected firms, which partially contributed to the redistribution of market power.
abstract_zh: 市场势力的构建成本高昂，且一旦形成便具有显著的持久性和难以改变的特征。本文探究了重大经济冲击（严重流行病）对制造业市场势力再分配的影响。通过构建企业生产、定价与库存持有动态决策模型，我们论证了库存规模与需求不确定性在理解市场势力中的关键作用，并提出了一种新的市场势力测度方法。研究发现，2003年中国非典疫情冲击显著降低了疫区企业的市场势力，且该效应具有长期持续性。非典疫情还大幅增加了受影响企业的库存水平，这在一定程度上推动了市场势力的再分配。
